rows.note: This is the all-purpose attributive expression for something characteristic of or related to birds.

example.english: This animal has avian characteristics and can fly.
example.traditional: 呢種動物有鳥類嘅特徵，識得飛。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 dung6 mat6 jau5 niu5 leoi6 ge3 dak6 zing1 sik1 dak1 fei1
